description: Main source code for the xajax PHP class library, version 0.2.4, providing Ajax functionality, request processing, and JavaScript generation.

classes.name: xajax
classes.description: Main class for managing Ajax requests, registering functions, generating JavaScript, and processing incoming requests.

methods.name: setRequestURI
methods.description: Sets the URI for Ajax requests.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers a PHP function or method to be callable via Ajax.

methods.name: processRequests
methods.description: Main engine to handle incoming Ajax requests, invoke PHP functions, and return XML responses.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript code needed to enable Ajax calls from the client side.
